newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks dip at close on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks dip at close on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks lost heavily as investors took profits after a four-session rally, brokers said.
The benchmark Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) index closed 88.04 points or 3.59 percent down at 2,362.52 on a turnover of 67.9 million taka. Of 79 traded issues, 65 lost and 14 gained.

"It seems investors have not fully shrugged off hestitation. They are still viewing holding shares for a longer period as risky," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. Dhaka stocks had recovered early last week from nearly a month-long bear trend.
Singer Bangladesh lost 1,423 taka to 13,869 and Square Pharma shed 179.81 to 1,621.74. --Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
